d: The Raipur-Dhanbad Economic Corridor (EC-07) is a transformative infrastructure project aimed at boosting industrial growth & connectivity in central & eastern India. This 707 km, four-lane, access-controlled expressway will connect major cities like Raipur, Bilaspur, Ranchi, and Dhanbad, passing through coal reserves and industrial areas. It's set to reduce travel time, promote trade, & create new economic opportunities in the region.
